notes.content: [p]Great news! Playtest players can now join matches with both [b]Lite[/b] and [b]Full[/b] game users. 🎮 This opens up more multiplayer possibilities and helps us test cross-version compatibility.[/p][p]⚠️ [b]Limitations apply[/b]: Some features and content may be restricted depending on the version you're using. Don’t forget to press [b]F12[/b] to report any bugs you encounter.[/p]

notes.title: 0.052 Notes
notes.content:
0.0.52 Update 🎉
Playtest is now open to EVERYONE! No need to wait! Yay!

Thank you for reporting bugs and being part of our team! Your feedback and bug reports are  incredibly valuable to us.

Fixes & Improvements:
✅ Big Shelf Fixed – No more unexpected placement issues. 
✅ Deck Boxes Resized – Enjoy a more streamlined inventory. 
✅ Trade UI Stuck Issue Resolved – Players won't be stuck when someone joins. 
✅ Join Button Fix – No more clicking multiple times—works smoothly now!
✅ Main Menu Lobby List UI Fix – Improved lobby visuals and organization. 
✅ Card Reveal Disconnect Bug Fixed – Say goodbye to unexpected disconnects.

Visual & Audio Enhancements:
✨ Warmer Color Palette – A more inviting and vibrant look. 🎵 New Background Music – Fresh tunes to enhance your gameplay experience.

📌 We are aware of ongoing disconnect issues. We've fixed some related problems, but we are still investigating to fully understand and resolve them. Please save your game often while we work on it!

...plus other bug fixes for a smoother playtest experience!

Jump in and test it out! 🚀

notes.title: New Features Are Live !
notes.content:
🛠️ [Update Patch Notes] — New Features & Fixes!
Hey everyone! We've just dropped a new update packed with features and improvements based on your feedback. Here's what’s new:

🌟 New Features
💾 Autosave when the host disconnects (never lose progress again!)

🌐 Public Lobbies — join games with other players anytime

🧃 Steam Inventory Integration — trade & earn in style!

📊 Level XP Balance — more rewarding progression

🧢 New Accessories to personalize your character

🐾 New Figurines added to the collection

💬 Chat Feature — talk with your team (or tease your rival!)

📱 QR Payment System for in-game payments (more realism!)

🧾 New Task System — structured goals for better gameplay

🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements
🧠 Fixed Intel GPU quality level issues (better visuals across devices)

🔊 Sound & Key Settings reset issue resolved

🪙 Price Set Bug squashed — your prices now stay as they should

📦 Shelf System Bugs fixed — no more disappearing items

🛠️ Various minor bug fixes and performance improvements

Thanks for all your feedback — keep it coming!
🧡 Don’t forget to wishlist, leave a review, or join our community!

notes.title: Version 0.0.40
notes.content:
📢 Version 0.0.40 Update Announcement 📢

Big thanks to our amazing TCG players! 🎉 Your feedback shapes this game, and we’re thrilled to have you on this journey with us.

🆕 What's New in 0.0.40?
Expanded Playtesting – New players can now join the action!

Card Catalog Filtering – Easily view only available cards in the catalog.

Balanced Card Reveal Packages – Better chance to pull rare cards! We’ve tweaked the system to make it more exciting.

Reduced Daily Trash Amount – Less clutter, smoother gameplay.

New Small Card Display – Selling cards at early levels is now easier.

Fixed Disconnect Issues – No more sudden dropouts!

Collision Bug Fixes – Say goodbye to unexpected card interactions.

🔧 Bug Reporting Reminder – Found a bug? Let us know so we can keep improving!

Enjoy the update and keep the feedback coming! 🔥🃏 Let’s build this game together! 🚀
